svg.title: When the checks run
svg.desc: Every pull request runs the required checks, and the scanners of what it changes: zizmor for a workflow, OSV-Scanner for a lock file, fuzzing for Python code and the link check for a document. The release pull request, which changes only the changelog and the version, runs the required checks without the scanners. After a merge, main runs only what keeps a baseline or publishes. Every week, main runs the scanners in full, the secret scan of the whole history, the SBOM and the newest Python.
